title: Digestible Energy Measurement by Proximate Analysis in Mice
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2vbge2n

steps.title: Prepare Mice and Initial Weights
steps.instruction: House mice singly in clean cages with fresh food, water, and low bedding. Record the initial weight of the mouse and the weight of the rodent diet provided ('food-in') in grams.

steps.title: Save Diet Samples
steps.instruction: Save several pellets of the rodent diet for energy or macronutrient content analysis.

substeps.instruction: Store pellets at 4°C in an airtight container.

steps.title: Monitor Food Intake
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and the remaining rodent diet ('food-out') in grams at specific intervals.

substeps.instruction: Perform weighing at the end of the 48-hour collection period.

steps.title: Collect Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Collect all feces from the cage bottoms and prepare them for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Swap cage bottoms with new clean bottoms, replace feeder insert/water bottle, and return animals to the housing system.
Carefully inspect and remove each piece of bedding using tweezers to collect all feces.
Inspect each fecal pellet to ensure no spilled food, hair fibers, or bedding are attached.
If significant food spillage is found in the cage bottom, weigh it in a pre-tared weigh boat to add back to the food measurement.
Place feces in a labeled, pre-weighed 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Determine Fecal Wet Weight
steps.instruction: Calculate the fecal 'wet' weight by subtracting the original tube weight from the weight of the tube containing the feces.

steps.title: Store and Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Store fecal samples at -80°C until analysis for bomb calorimetry and proximate analysis, then ship to the Mouse Biology Program.

substeps.instruction: Enclose the fecal/diet sample log with samples.
Send samples on dry ice to: Mouse Biology Program C/O UC Davis MMPC, University of California, 2795 Second Street, Suite 400, Davis, CA 95618.
Include the MBP/MMPC project # in the reference section of the package documentation.
Send the FedEx/UPS tracking number to mmpc-bodyc@ucdavis.edu.
